response.sql: WITH album_rates AS (SELECT AlbumId, AVG(UnitPrice) AS avg_unit_price, AVG(CAST(Bytes AS REAL) / Milliseconds) AS bytes_per_ms FROM Track GROUP BY AlbumId) SELECT AlbumId, avg_unit_price, bytes_per_ms, bytes_per_ms - (SELECT AVG(bytes_per_ms) FROM album_rates) AS diff_from_overall_avg FROM album_rates ORDER BY diff_from_overall_avg DESC LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: 'Average rate across all albums' is the unweighted mean of the per-album rates (each album group counts once, including the NULL-album group), not the mean over all individual tracks.
Tracks with NULL AlbumId form one group, which is included in the ranking and in the overall average.
Bytes is cast to REAL to avoid integer division; tracks with NULL Bytes are ignored by AVG, and Milliseconds is NOT NULL (assumed non-zero).

alternatives.interpretation: The overall average rate is computed over all individual tracks (track-weighted) rather than as the mean of album rates.
